content:
Set \(n\) = circles along a side of the square. Then the triangle has \(n+14\) per side.

Equate filled totals:
\[
n^2 = \frac{(n+14)(n+15)}{2}
\]
\[
2n^2 = n^2+29n+210
\]
\[
n^2-29n-210=0
\]
\[
n=\frac{29\pm 41}{2}
\]
Positive solution: \(n=35\).

Total circles:
\[
35^2=1225
\]

\boxed{1225}
